originalVisual: One single thick yellow rectangular plate, clipped corners, four small gold dots and a pale central raised strip.
Hard broad planar shading and simple construction. Edge thickness reads as a dark ochre block; the small fasteners do not read as metal.
targetVisual: Warm yellow enamel with broad rounded edge bands, orange inset seams and richer bottom/side depth.
Four visibly domed gray metal fasteners with gold collars, multiple purposeful inset surfaces, a pale raised strip and carefully shaped bevel transitions.
The painted target is a single uninterrupted rectangular plaque; its silhouette is an aesthetic reference and cannot overrule the declared pair of narrow native hull mounting regions.
styleVisual: Soft broad highlights and saturated warm color; curved edge transitions provide volume while major planes remain legible.
Small details should support the volume without noisy faceting or extreme dark crevices.

nativeSource.construction: two eight-vertex box meshes with bevel modifiers plus four 16-vertex fasteners
nativeSource.inspectionCaveat: The raw stored object inspection precedes explicit dependency-graph evaluation; final source/geometry audits will use evaluated matrices and vertices.

initialImplementationIntent: Build two independent shallow armor panels with substantial finite flat underside seating, rounded enamel construction, a restrained pale inset and paired domed silver fasteners. Keep central corridor open. Use physical geometry and one symmetric light recipe. Verify native geometry and runtime registration before submission.
